items.text: Among adults treated for hip fracture on the trauma unit from 2022 to 2024, is mobilisation by a physiotherapist within 24 hours of surgery associated with the odds of a stay longer than 28 days, after adjustment for age, pre-fracture mobility, dementia, operation type and American Society of Anesthesiologists grade?
items.population: Adults treated for hip fracture on the trauma unit, 2022 to 2024
items.intervention: First mobilisation (standing or walking with a physiotherapist) within 24 hours of surgery (exposure)
items.setting: Orthopaedic trauma unit of a 700-bed hospital

finer: Feasible within 100 hours by case-control sampling; interesting to therapy managers and planners; novel for this unit's case mix; ethical as secondary use with a waiver request; relevant to a staffing decision in April 2027.
summary: One PECO question with prolonged stay as the outcome.
